meta.title: m5stack-pc-remote System Architecture
meta.subtitle: Telegram-relayed Wake/Reboot/Shutdown for a home Windows PC

views.label: Full system
views.note: Every hop from the smartphone to the physical PC.

views.label: Authenticated command path
views.note: The only path that can trigger reboot/shutdown: HMAC-signed LAN request, then a local OS command.

views.label: External access (no inbound port)
views.note: M5Stack polls Telegram outbound; nothing is exposed to the internet.

cards.title: Security
items: REBOOT/SHUTDOWN require HMAC-SHA256 signature + timestamp (±60s skew) + single-use nonce
TLS root CA pinned for Telegram (Go Daddy G2, hardcoded in firmware/src/telegram_root_ca.rs)
Telegram commands accepted only from TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USER_ID (strict from.id match)
dry_run = true by default in m5stack-pc-bridge/config.toml; must be explicitly disabled

cards.title: Failure / recovery paths
items: Unauthorized Telegram user or invalid/expired timestamp/nonce: request ignored, command never executed
m5stack-pc-bridge crash: Windows Service Recovery restarts it (sc.exe failure action)
Wi-Fi drop on M5Stack: reconnect every 15s; Telegram getUpdates failure: backoff 5s–60s

cards.title: Secret boundaries
items: BRIDGE_SHARED_SECRET: known only to M5Stack and m5stack-pc-bridge
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: known only to M5Stack and Telegram, never forwarded to the bridge
